description: This file is a shell script for testing git repository behavior, specifically testing how git rev-list handles corrupted commit objects. It sets up a git repository, commits files, corrupts a commit object, and runs various git commands to verify the handling of these scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of its commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting the commands within to fail according to the test framework.
